 Michigan Muslims helped elect Trump. Now their faith is under fire
 Michigan’s Muslim voters helped Donald Trump win in 2024. Now, Abdul El-Sayed is running to become the US’ first Muslim senator, his faith and loyalty are under attack. Al Jazeera’s Mikail Malik spoke to Muslim Americans in Dearborn.
